item.title: Exact Spelling For Repair Logo

The ONLY text must be exactly "KwickFixx" — uppercase K, lowercase wick, uppercase F, lowercase i, and exactly two lowercase x characters at the end. Spell KwickFixx precisely, as one word. Use bold highly legible black lettering in a modern friendly sans-serif typeface. Place one small orange wrench icon to the left of the shop name, subordinate to the lettering. Center the balanced horizontal icon-and-wordmark composition inside the square canvas with generous white space. Flat vector-style design, crisp edges, simple memorable silhouette, strong contrast. No slogan, no tagline, no additional words or letters, no border, no mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no textures.
